Fix: record the applied event's start time in a new field eventAt and compare against that (a file without it accepts the event). SubagentStart/SubagentStop older than eventAt still add or remove their subagent (the map is keyed by agent ID, so order doesn't matter) but change nothing else. tasks.name: Hook: track background subagents from background_tasks
tasks.description: A background subagent fires SubagentStop each time it pauses to wait on its own background work, and SubagentStart when it resumes, so the list drops agents Claude Code still shows as working. Stop and SubagentStop payloads carry background_tasks, the parent session's in-flight task registry (hooks docs › Stop input). Use it: entries of type 'subagent' (not in a finished status) are running background subagents, keyed by id (= agent_id), marked background. On Stop the subagent list becomes exactly those (no foreground subagent runs while the main agent stops). On SubagentStop, the stopping agent stays when it is still in the list (paused), other background-marked agents missing from the list are removed, foreground ones are left alone; an older SubagentStop only removes or keeps its own agent. Without background_tasks the old add/remove rules apply. Keep each agent's first since. Update doc/state-file-schema.md, HookEventsTests, a payload fixture.
